177:t_1:169.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「No... Federation forces under $$クロノ$$ reconditioned her and made her the pilot of a black $$ユニコーン$$.」

177:t_1:171.en:
$$宗介$$
「They intended to pit the same model against $$バナージ$$'s $$ユニコーン$$.」

177:t_1:172.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...With Captain $$ジンネマン$$ of the $$ガランシェール$$ helping in that battle, we rescued $$マリーダ$$, but Ensign $$リディ$$...」

177:t_1:173.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「MIA... He was declared missing in action.」

177:t_1:176.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「After the battle, Colonel $$シャア$$ returned to the colonies with $$マリーダ$$ and the $$ガランシェール$$ team.」

177:t_1:177.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then $$フル・フロンタル$$ announced his Declaration of Succession to Earth's Humanity.」

177:t_1:179.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「With the Earth Federation weakened, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ would build relations with the Empire as the legitimate successor to Earth's humanity.」

177:t_1:180.en:
$$宗介$$
「So he effectively declared surrender and subservience.」

177:t_1:181.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But people frightened by the Empire's overwhelming power will accept that.」

177:t_1:182.en:
$$シン$$
「And $$プラント$$ accepted it, too...」

177:t_1:184.en:
$$キラ$$
「The secret behind the creation of $$コーディネイター$$s was connected to $$プラント$$'s support for $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

177:t_1:185.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$コーディネイター$$s are the genetically modified humans living in $$プラント$$, right?」

177:t_1:186.en:
$$キラ$$
「That genetic modification was carried out by the Reformists, who split from the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

177:t_1:188.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$クロノ$$'s influence reached even that far!?」

177:t_1:189.en:
$$シン$$
「The conflict between $$ナチュラル$$s and $$プラント$$... between Earth and space... was a struggle between $$クロノ$$'s Conservatives and Reformists...」

177:t_1:190.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$ラクス$$ told me about it in $$プラント$$...」

177:t_1:191.en:
$$キラ$$
「And $$ラクス$$, who still calls for peace, is being hunted by $$ザフト$$, which has allied with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

177:t_1:192.en:
$$シン$$
「And $$レイ#pt136$$ became Chairman of the National Defense Committee, the head of $$ザフト$$...」

177:t_1:193.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$レイ#pt136$$... That's the friend you told us about...」

177:t_1:194.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「His full name is $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$... He's a clone of someone, and he'd been away from $$ザフト$$ to recuperate...」

177:t_1:195.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「But before we knew it, he'd become the head of $$ザフト$$ with $$フル・フロンタル$$'s backing...」

177:t_1:196.en:
$$シン$$
「I... don't understand what $$レイ#pt136$$ is thinking...」

177:t_1:197.en:
$$シン$$
「But he's my friend... So I'll stop him...!」

177:t_1:198.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「I know, $$シン$$... I'll back you up.」

177:t_1:200.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$ and the others are in $$プラント$$, too. They're protecting $$ラクス$$, so I believe she'll be all right...」

177:t_1:201.en:
$$キラ$$
「So let's focus on ending this war.」

177:t_1:202.en:
$$甲児$$
「Understood. We'll do everything we can, too.」

177:t_1:203.en:
$$シン$$
(Wait for me, $$レイ#pt136$$... I'll talk things through with you, no matter what.)

177:t_1:204.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Ensign $$リディ$$... You sacrificed yourself to save my life...)

177:t_1:205.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I will never waste... the possibilities you saved for me.)

177:t_1:206.en:
$n
(Everyone is finding their own resolve to fight...)

177:t_1:210.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry. I interrupted your thoughts.」

177:t_1:212.en:
$$セツコ$$
「You don't need to be nervous. I'm not after your $$スフィア$$.」

177:t_1:214.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Let me introduce myself properly. I'm $$セツコ・オハラ$$...」

177:t_1:215.en:
$$セツコ$$
「As you sensed, I'm the $$悲しみの乙女$$'s $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

177:t_1:216.en:
$n
「I'm $F. It's a pleasure to meet you.」

177:t_1:217.en:
$$セツコ$$
「May I call you $n, like everyone else?」

177:t_1:219.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Don't be so nervous. I'm a little older, but there's not that much difference between our ages.」

177:t_1:221.en:
$$メール$$
「That's not it, $$セツコ$$. I'm sure $n is just shy around you.」

177:t_1:223.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're a boy after all, $n. You get like this the moment you see someone pretty.」

177:t_1:225.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You can't hide it. I've thought for a while that you have a weakness for older women, $n.」

177:t_1:227.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Though I'm older than him, too...)

177:t_1:229.en:
$n
「I'm right in the middle of it.」

177:t_1:230.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Hehe... I thought you'd be more sensitive, so this is a bit unexpected...」

177:t_1:231.en:
$$ランド$$
「Of course. I'm $n's master when it comes to smiling.」

177:t_1:232.en:
$$メール$$
「With Darling's elite training, $n's trying to stop being the quiet type.」

177:t_1:233.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then $$ランド$$ is the best possible teacher.」

177:t_1:236.en:
$n
「I... have something I'd like you to teach me, too, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:237.en:
$$メール$$
(Could it be...!? The ABCs of love!?)

177:t_1:238.en:
$$ランド$$
(Don't, $$メール$$. Miss $$スズネ$$ won't stand for jokes like that.)

177:t_1:240.en:
$n
「$$シン$$ told me you were in the Federation's combat tactics research team, $$セツコ$$.」

177:t_1:241.en:
$n
「Please. I'd like you to coach me in piloting.」

177:t_1:242.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...You're a member of $c, so I think you fight well enough already...」

177:t_1:243.en:
$n
「Well enough isn't enough. I... want to get stronger.」

177:t_1:244.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Improving your skills beyond this point will be harder than you imagine.」

177:t_1:246.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...I'm not as strong as Captain $$アムロ$$, but I have some confidence in my precise piloting.」

177:t_1:247.en:
$$セツコ$$
「My superior trained me rigorously in that.」
